srv.props.field.network-compression-thre: Packets larger than this many bytes are compressed. -1 disables compression.
srv.props.field.online-mode.desc: Verify players with Mojang accounts. Turn off only if you know what you are doing.
srv.props.field.op-permission-level.desc: Permission level given to operators (0 to 4).
srv.props.field.player-idle-timeout.desc: Minutes before idle players are kicked. 0 disables it.
srv.props.field.pvp.desc: Allow players to damage each other.
srv.props.field.server-port.desc: Port the server listens on (1024 to 65535).
srv.props.field.simulation-distance.desc: How far from players the world is simulated, in chunks (3 to 32).
srv.props.field.spawn-protection.desc: Radius around the spawn point that only operators can modify. 0 disables it.
srv.props.field.view-distance.desc: How many chunks are sent to each player (3 to 32).

srv.start.customFlagDuplicate: This flag is already in the list
srv.start.flag.aikar-flag: Aikar flags: one of the tuning options from the widely used Aikar flag set for Paper-style servers.
srv.start.flag.aikar-new: Aikar flags: young generation sizing option from the same set.
srv.start.flag.always-pre-touch: Reserve all of the allocated memory when the server starts. Uses more RAM up front but avoids slowdowns later.
srv.start.flag.disable-explicit-gc: Ignore System.gc() calls from plugins so they cannot cause lag spikes.
srv.start.flag.g1-heap-region: Size of each G1 heap region.
srv.start.flag.g1-heap-waste: How much free memory G1 tolerates before it collects more aggressively.
srv.start.flag.g1-max-new-size: Percentage of the heap used for new objects (young generation), maximum.
srv.start.flag.g1-mixed-count: Target number of mixed collections after a marking cycle.
srv.start.flag.g1-mixed-live: Minimum live-object threshold for a region to be included in mixed collections.
srv.start.flag.g1-new-size: Percentage of the heap used for new objects (young generation), minimum.
srv.start.flag.g1-reserve: Percentage of the heap kept free as a reserve.
srv.start.flag.g1-rset: Time budget for updating remembered sets, as a percentage.
srv.start.flag.g1gc: Use the G1 garbage collector, a good general choice for Minecraft servers.
srv.start.flag.ihop: Heap occupancy at which G1 starts a background marking cycle.
srv.start.flag.max-gc-pause: Target maximum garbage collection pause time (in milliseconds).
srv.start.flag.max-tenuring: Maximum number of collections an object survives before moving to the old generation.
srv.start.flag.parallel-ref-proc: Process garbage collection references in parallel to shorten pauses.
srv.start.flag.perf-disable: Disable JVM performance data memory-mapped file to avoid disk stalls.
srv.start.flag.survivor-ratio: Ratio between the eden space and each survivor space.
srv.start.flag.unlock-experimental: Unlock experimental JVM options so the tuning flags below can be used.
srv.start.jarInvalid: The file name must end with .jar and must not contain a path.
srv.start.noFlags: This Java version has no suggested flags. You can still add your own below.
srv.start.restartNeeded: The server is running. Changes apply the next time it starts.
srv.start.title: Start options
